Weakening Venom
20% of base mana
1 sec cast
Activate Weakening Venom for 2 hr, giving your casts a 35% chance to deal 18+4.8 Points Per Level+SP*.125 Shadow damage and reduce an enemy's attack power by -(-3.4 Points Per Level+ -23) for 8 sec.

You can have a maximum of 2 unique Venoms active at a time.
